title: The derived tensor counit on internal complex representatives
statement: The total left derived scalar tensor comparison satisfies its counit equation on the homotopy quotients of two internal complexes, with the quotient of the signed complex tensor and the quotient of the complex oplax tensor map written explicitly.

source.place: Tag 07A4, comparison with signed total-complex representatives; the counit characterization of the left derived tensor comparison.

proof.text: Apply the existing general derived tensor counit equation to the two homotopy quotient objects. The strict quotient tensor product and the definitions of mapHomotopyCategory and its oplax comparison identify all objects and maps with the displayed complex expressions.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientScalarTensor_homotopyComplex (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z) ℤ) :
    let := internalScalarMonoidal a Z
    let F := Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a Z)
    let qR := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z) (.up ℤ)
    let qS := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules S Z) (.up ℤ)
    let Fc := F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    F.leftDerivedFunctor.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh (qR.obj P) (qR.obj Q)) ≫
        F.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app (qR.obj (P ⊗ Q)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans (.up ℤ) F).app P).app Q) =
      ((F.leftDerivedTensorComparison.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) ≫
        (F.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app (qR.obj P) ⊗ₘ
          F.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app (qR.obj Q)) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh (qS.obj (Fc.obj P)) (qS.obj (Fc.obj Q))
